Results.ReviewText: The Spirit II E-310 has met my expectations well. The cast iron grates coupled with the stainless burners are the biggest and best features. They are best in class. The igniter seems to be far advanced to previous versions used on many grill brands. The platform is solid and plenty robust for a mostly stationary grill. The size of the grill surface is perfect for mostly cooking for a couple people by using just two burners. It adequately handles the need to occasionally cook for a larger group employing all three burners. I've had an entire beef tenderloin cut into steaks (about 15 steaks) on the grill at one time. The only problem and the one that keeps me from giving it 5 stars is the side table opposite the wheels (left side - facing the grill). It is the one that will fold down (the other, right side, is stationary). The latch just will not hold when you tilt the grill off its legs to roll it around. If you fold it down, there is nothing to hold on to so that you can lift one side up and move the grill about. It's a disappointment every time I have to move it for any reason. Suggest revising the side table with a more sturdy latch in the up position or provide some sort of handle with the table in the down position.
Results.Title: Solid Grill

Results.ReviewText: I grill outside at least 4 nights a week all year long. After much dissatisfaction with a competitor grill, I purchased a Weber grill four months ago.
